Name: Birthday Reminder Mod
Author: laceihaim
Description:
Birthday Reminder Mod
Never miss an NPC birthday in Stardew Valley with the Birthday Reminder Mod.
Features:
[list]
[*]Daily Notifications: Receive alerts on your in-game birthdays.
[*]Gift Suggestions: View each birthday NPC’s favorite gifts to strengthen relationships.
[*]NPC Schedule: The location and time interval for where to find the NPC.
[/list]How to Use:
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI: Ensure SMAPI is installed.
[*]Download the Mod: Get the Birthday Reminder Mod from CurseForge.
[*]Launch the Game: Start Stardew Valley through SMAPI.
[*]Receive Alerts: On an NPC’s birthday, a pink cake button will appear on the UI, clicking it opens the birthday frame.
[/list] 
Opening the Notification:
[list]
[*]Mouse/Keyboard Users: Hover the pink cake and press [b]Mouse1[/b].
[*]Controller Users: Hover the pink cake and press the [b]B[/b] button.
[/list]Closing the Notification:
[list]
[*]Keyboard Users: Press the [b]Escape [/b]button.
[*]Controller Users: Press the [b]B[/b] button to close the message.
[/list]
